sources.title: India breaks New Zealand Test record with monster innings in Wellington
A six to reach 100! Rishabh Pant reveals the habit that has also cost him centuries

en.title: India declares 9-720 in Wellington, highest Test score in New Zealand
en.dek: India declared 9-720 in Wellington, achieving the highest team total in a Test played in New Zealand.
facts: India declared 9-720 in Wellington, achieving the highest team total in a Test played in New Zealand.
KL Rahul scored 136 and Rishabh Pant scored 128 in India's first innings.
India took a 352-run first-innings lead over New Zealand after New Zealand made 368.
Rishabh Pant's 128 included six sixes, bringing his career tally to 108 sixes in 53 Tests.
New Zealand was 2-119 at the close of play on day four.
body: India declared 9-720 in their first innings in Wellington, achieving the highest team total in a Test played in New Zealand. Centuries from KL Rahul (136) and Rishabh Pant (128) allowed India to attain a 352-run first-innings lead over New Zealand.
Rishabh Pant's innings of 128 included six sixes. New Zealand reached 2-119 at the close of play on day four as it fought to save the first Test after India's declaration.
en.context: India toured New Zealand for the first Test in Wellington. India declared on a mammoth 9-720, putting themselves in a commanding position.

pt.title: Índia declara 9-720 em Wellington, maior pontuação em Testes na Nova Zelândia
pt.dek: A Índia declarou 9-720 em Wellington, alcançando o maior total de equipa num Teste disputado na Nova Zelândia.
facts: A Índia declarou 9-720 em Wellington, alcançando o maior total de equipa num Teste disputado na Nova Zelândia.
KL Rahul marcou 136 e Rishabh Pant marcou 128 na primeira entrada da Índia.
A Índia obteve uma vantagem de 352 corridas na primeira entrada sobre a Nova Zelândia, após a Nova Zelândia marcar 368.
Os 128 de Rishabh Pant incluíram seis seis, elevando o seu total de carreira para 108 seis em 53 Testes.
A Nova Zelândia estava 2-119 no final do dia quatro.
body: A Índia declarou 9-720 na sua primeira entrada em Wellington, alcançando a maior pontuação de equipa num Teste disputado na Nova Zelândia. Centenários de KL Rahul (136) e Rishabh Pant (128) permitiram à Índia obter uma vantagem de 352 corridas na primeira entrada sobre a Nova Zelândia.
A entrada de Rishabh Pant, com 128 corridas, incluiu seis seis. A Nova Zelândia atingiu 2-119 no final do dia quatro, enquanto lutava para salvar o primeiro Teste após a declaração da Índia.
pt.context: A Índia visitou a Nova Zelândia para o primeiro Teste em Wellington. A Índia declarou com um avultado 9-720, colocando-se numa posição dominante.

zh.title: 印度在惠灵顿宣告9-720，创新西兰测试赛最高得分
zh.dek: 印度在惠灵顿宣告9-720，取得新西兰测试赛最高团队总分
facts: 印度在惠灵顿宣告9-720，取得新西兰测试赛最高团队总分
KL 拉胡尔得136分，里什布尔·潘特得128分，印度第一局得分
印度第一局取得352分的领先优势，因为新西兰局内得368分
潘特的128分包含六记六棒，生涯五十三场测试赛中得到108记六棒

body: 印度在惠灵顿宣告9-720，创新西兰测试赛最高得分
拉胡尔（136）和帕特尔（128）的世纪帮助印度取得352分的首局领先优势。帕特尔的128分局内打出六记六球。第四天结束时，新西兰以2-119的比分收工，试图挽救首场测试赛。
zh.context: 印度首次巡新西兰进行测试赛，在惠灵顿宣告9-720，占据有利位置

problemsFixed: Facts 4 and 5 in the 'facts' array are unsupported or misattributed in the sources. Fact 4 claims Pant's six tally is 108 in 53 Tests and that he surpassed McCullum; the source text confirms the 108 figure and that he surpassed McCullum, but the context (McCullum's dismissal) is not in the provided ABC text. Fact 5 states NZ was 2-119 at close of day four and 233 runs from forcing India to bat again; the source states NZ was 2-119 and 233 runs from forcing India to bat again, which is supported. However, the 'dek' references 'highest team total in a Test played in New Zealand' which requires careful attribution per style guide 1 and 3. The draft body paragraph 1 appends a comparison to India's all-time highest score (7-759) without a sourced attribution for that specific number in the Wellington context, violating style guide 1. The draft body paragraph 2 contains 'now second behind Ben Stokes (138)' which is not in the provided ABC text. The draft opens multiple paragraphs with 'India' (violating style guide 13). The headline is 91 characters, exceeding the 90-char limit. The 'context' field contains a claim about a 'two-Test series' and 'putting themselves in a commanding position to win the match' which is not explicitly sourced as a series claim in the ABC text (only one Test is detailed).
